steps.en: Install the agent custom resource definitions
steps.zh: 安装 agent 的自定义资源定义

steps.en: Install the controller and point it at an LLM provider
steps.zh: 装控制器并指明 LLM 供应商

steps.en: Declare an agent, its model config and the tools it may use
steps.zh: 声明 agent、它的模型配置与可用工具

steps.en: Reconciles the Agent resource into the workload that runs it
steps.zh: 把 Agent 资源 reconcile 成实际运行它的负载

steps.en: Runs the agent on the ADK engine and calls tools over MCP tool servers
steps.zh: 用 ADK 引擎运行 agent，经 MCP 工具服务器调工具

steps.en: Traces every agent and tool call with OpenTelemetry for inspection
steps.zh: 用 OpenTelemetry 追踪每次 agent 与工具调用

value.en: Agents become Kubernetes objects your platform team can deploy, observe and govern with the tooling it already runs
value.zh: agent 变成 Kubernetes 对象，平台团队用既有工具就能部署、观测与治理

sources: https://github.com/kagent-dev/kagent/blob/main/helm/README.md (helm install kagent-crds ./helm/kagent-crds/ --namespace kagent; helm install kagent ./helm/kagent/ --namespace kagent with provider flags)
https://github.com/kagent-dev/kagent#technical-details (Agent/ModelConfig/ToolServer CRDs; controller + UI + engine on ADK + CLI; MCP tool servers; OpenTelemetry)
